text:
zoe_peopleops: Heads-up: finalizing the Q2 review logistics tonight. Two quick clarifications before I publish: (1) grace period policy for self-assessments, (2) how to handle managers who are partial-OOO during calibration. Please drop a one-line reply. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jamal_peopleops: For self-assessments, we can allow a 48-hour grace if there's a documented launch conflict. Managers should add a short note in the form explaining the reason.

linda_hr: Confirming Jamal's guidance. Also adding: late entries after the 48-hour grace require manager pre-approval and will be marked in the audit log. Official deadlines in the final doc will be: self-assessments due 2026-04-10 23:59 PDT, manager comments due 2026-04-12 17:00 PDT, final uploads 2026-04-13 12:00 PDT.

zoe_peopleops: Great. Async calibration: do we want to keep the "vote + comment" flow on the shared sheet, or switch to the pulse survey for absent managers?

dev-manager-sam: vote + comment on the sheet is easiest. Pulse survey adds overhead and fragments records. If someone is out, they can leave an async vote and note in the sheet and the lead will record it.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: calibration leads need to confirm slots by 18:00 today. Unconfirmed slots will be tentatively auto-assigned.

jamal_peopleops: Calibration leads confirmed: Zoe (Mon 15:00-16:30), Jamal (Tue 09:30-11:00), Priya (Wed 13:00-14:30). I'll create calendar invites once Zoe publishes final timeline.

linda_hr: Upload checklist (short):
- IC self-assessments -> Forms link: https://redwoodcompany.share/reviews/q2-2026-form
- Manager comments -> upload folder: /Shared/Reviews/2026-Q2/managers
- Calibration votes -> sheet: https://redwoodcompany.share/sheets/calibration-q2
- Audit notes -> add to the "notes" column on the sheet

zoe_peopleops: Thanks all. One last thing: managers, please forward this 3-line guidance to your teams: "What to include: top 3 outcomes (metrics where possible), two examples of collaboration/impact, and 1 growth goal for the next 6 months. Keep it ~200-300 words and attach links to 1-2 artifacts."

dev-manager-sam: Will do. Also flagging: if any IC needs an extension beyond the 48-hour grace, DM me and I'll escalate.

zoe_peopleops: Filing final timeline tonight and posting to #announcements tomorrow AM. Appreciate the quick replies :rocket:
